papers.headline: Testing Refracted Gravity with the kinematics of stacked galaxy clusters
papers.summary: We test Refracted Gravity (RG), a phenomenological modified gravity model that modifies the Poisson equation by introducing an effective gravitational permittivity ε(ρ_bar) which depends on the baryonic matter density ρ_bar and mimics the behaviour of dark matter in cosmic structures.
papers.title: Testing Refracted Gravity with the kinematics of stacked galaxy clusters

papers.headline: Production of White Dwarf Debris Disks from Planetary Collisions and Poynting-Robertson Drag
papers.summary: This paper explores the production of debris disks around white dwarfs, which are observed to experience frequent pollution events.
papers.title: Production of White Dwarf Debris Disks from Planetary Collisions and Poynting-Robertson Drag

papers.headline: Unveiling the Origins of the Molecular Gas Reservoirs in Recently Quenched Massive Galaxies
papers.summary: Observations of quenched galaxies across cosmic time have revealed systems containing substantial molecular gas reservoirs, challenging the traditional picture of gas-poor, red and dead galaxies.
papers.title: Unveiling the Origins of the Molecular Gas Reservoirs in Recently Quenched Massive Galaxies
